verdict.rationale: Convex documents its own first-party Convex Auth library, which builds sign-up and sign-in flows using social identity providers and passwords, so the core capability is native. However, the docs scope it to client-side React and React Native apps, and nothing shows setup takes only minutes; other frameworks are pointed to third-party providers such as Clerk, Auth0 and WorkOS. missing for 10: evidence of quick setup, support beyond React/React Native, detailed OAuth provider setup docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add email/password and social OAuth sign-in with the platform SDK in minutes

citations.quote: helps you build a custom sign-up/sign-in flow via social identity providers, one-time email or SMS access codes, or via passwords.
For client-side React and React Native mobile apps you can implement auth directly in Convex with the Convex Auth library.
